fluff.overview:
The Taurian Defense Force assigns conventional infantry to garrison and planetary defense roles across the Concordat, where citizen-soldiers serve out of patriotic duty rather than mere obligation. Mechanized wheeled platoons offer a balance of speed and economy, their wheeled transports being cheaper to maintain than hover or tracked alternatives. For a military that must stretch limited resources across a significant number of garrison worlds, this cost efficiency matters as much as tactical performance.

Support troops carry man-portable flamers that project streams of burning chemicals over several hundred square meters, providing devastating area-effect capability against infantry and structures at the cost of short range and the vulnerability of the operator's fuel tank.
